name: Alice Seohyun Lee
title: About — Alice Lee
text:
ALICE LEE
GRAPHIC DESIGN & ILLUSTRATION
Portfolio About Resume
HELLO! I’M ALICE SEOHYUN LEE.

Born in South Korea, raised in California, now running amok in Missouri.

In 2018 I graduated with a BFA in Communication Design from Washington University in St. Louis. Since then I’ve been working as a designer in branding and marketing agencies around the city, occasionally flexing my illustrator muscles for a wide-ranging roster of clients.

In my free time, I am watching Great British Bake Off, writing, improvising pasta recipes, and trying to enjoy running.

Look at me, pretending to focus on wireframes, very candid

Need a designer? A thinker? 
A listening ear?
